caveats: Review counts and star ratings attributed to Google were partly read from Google Maps' limited guest view (rating only) and partly from Birdeye/Loc8NearMe mirrors of Google reviews, which is why the two sometimes differ by a tenth of a star.

Google web search (google.com/search) returned a bot-check page, so ratings were collected from the Maps interface instead of the search results panel; per-listing review counts were not visible there.
No forms were submitted, no accounts created and no messages sent. Contact and booking forms were inspected only up to the first input.
